correctness.rationale: For every \(m\ge4\), the restriction \(H^0(\mathcal O_C(2))\to H^0(L|_D)\) has rank three. A universal injective proper three-dimensional family is defined by line-section divisors and constant summand quotients. At a transverse divisor, the rank-three determinantal tangent conditions reduce to \(aR_1\subset R_2\) and \(bR_2\subset R_2\) in \(\mathbb C[t]/P(t)\), where \(R_j=\langle1,t,\dots,t^j\rangle\); degrees at most three are below \(m\), so \(a\in R_1\) and \(b\) is constant. Thus the tangent dimension is three and the family is a generically smooth component. All quantifiers and boundary cases are explicit; the finite checker returned VERIFY_OK for degrees \(3\le m\le14\) as corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The all-degree statement isolates and proves generic regularity of a natural 3-dimensional irreducible component of a highly overdetermined secant Quot degeneracy scheme, with exact tangent-space formula and sharp m≥4 boundary. It concretely distinguishes the natural dualized dimension bound in genera 10,15,21 from the literal published conjecture. Such component geometry is a motivated structural answer, not a routine isolated count.
